disclaimer: PROOF RUN ONLY. The target series is Job-SDF (NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks): real job advertisements collected from Chinese online recruitment platforms, with anonymised ids (skills and occupations are numbered, not named). It is used only to demonstrate that the method finds real signal in real job-market data. It is NOT Malaysian market data and says nothing about the Malaysian labour market. Non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 per the paper).

tiers.2: Curated listings or policy coverage. Leading but noisy.

time_grid.model_periods: monthly, month start (run with PERIOD_FREQ=M); horizon, windows and gate are counted in these periods

keys.granularity: native granularity of the source's periods; the period is identified by its start date
keys.release_lag_days: a figure for period P is only known release_lag_days after the period ends (default 0)
keys.min_period_postings: adapters drop periods with fewer total job ads than this
keys.min_entity_total: adapters keep an entity only if it has at least this many matches over the kept periods
keys.dense: true: every period between first and last kept period must exist and is zero-filled

sources.name: Job-SDF job-ad skill demand (share of job ads per skill and per L1 occupation), TARGET series
sources.license: Paper: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike); the GitHub page states no license. Used only as a method-validation dataset.
